lesile-yin-agent-skills-audit-swarm.description: Fan out 4–5 role-specialised audit agents (regression / security / performance / coverage / style) over a code change, then merge findings with a noise-filtered severity model. Use as a wider-net alternative to a single review pass, or as a complement to prism-review when a change needs breadth.

lesile-yin-agent-skills-caveman.description: Compress verbose agent/human communication into dense "caveman" mode — strip hedging, restatement, politeness, and meta-commentary while preserving 100% of the technical meaning. Use when a message, transcript, or tool output is token-heavy, repeats itself, or will be re-fed to an agent; typically saves 65–75% of output tokens with zero information loss.

lesile-yin-agent-skills-grill-me.description: Break single-model echo-chamber effects by having one model plan and another challenge the plan across up to three rounds. Use when a design is self-consistent but untested, when you suspect confirmation bias in a plan, or before committing to a large build that only one model has seen.

lesile-yin-agent-skills-prism-review.description: Multi-lens parallel code review. Splits one change into four independent review lenses — correctness, security, performance, contracts — runs them in parallel as read-only passes, then merges findings into a severity-ranked report with noise filtered out. Use before merging non-trivial changes, and automatically escalate to deep review when auth/payment/crypto paths are touched.

lesile-yin-agent-skills-prompt-forge.description: Forge vague natural-language requests into precise, engineering-grade prompts using the CRAFT framework (Context, Role, Action, Format, Tests). Use when a user's requirement is ambiguous, causes rework, or needs to be handed to another AI agent or teammate. Works for coding, writing, and analysis tasks.

lesile-yin-agent-skills-slide-smith.description: Batch PowerPoint automation with python-pptx. Audits deck structure, standardizes typography/colors/spacing against design tokens, and performs safe bulk text operations across many decks. Use when processing courseware or training material at scale, unifying inconsistent decks to a house style, or preparing accessibility-friendly (large-type, high-contrast) variants.

lesile-yin-agent-skills-token-saviour.description: Route each sub-task to the cheapest adequate tool across a 4-layer routing table (serena / rtk / caveman / Ponytail), cutting overall token spend by ~70%. Use when an agent loop's context is ballooning, when choosing between heavy and light tooling for a sub-task, or when budgeting a long-running job.

lesile-yin-agent-skills-token-warden.description: Token budget guardian for agent sessions. Models token consumption in four independent layers (context reading, tool/command output, conversation output, code generation), routes each layer to its most efficient tool or behavior, and enforces anti-pattern rules. Use in long coding sessions, large-repo work, or whenever the user asks to save tokens/cost, or a session starts hitting context limits.
